snippet.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered | Story Trailer | Out October 29
snippet.description:
A murder in Fabletown. A sheriff with a dark past. Bigby Wolf's first case pulls him deeper into a conspiracy, and the closer he gets to the truth, the harder it is to keep the wolf in check. Watch the story unfold, then get the first look at Bigby's redesigned werewolf form.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller, with enhanced visuals, upgraded animation and audio, an all-new Noir Mode, behind-the-scenes bonus content, and for the first time, playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown.  Myths and legends live secretly among us and every choice carries consequences.

Fairytales are real. Murder is just the beginning.

Available October 29, 2026.

WISHLIST NOW!
